propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) have no test coverage beyond a single page despite using opaque nextPageToken cursor pagination
The existing test suite only exercises single-page responses with isLast=True and never validates cursor advancement or multi-page recovery across paginated results
A repeated cursor token causes the readers to spin forever due to missing same-token-twice guards present in fetcher._iter_pages, converting to silent truncation via fail-open exception handling
The structural AST guard preventing unpaginated whole-project readers exists only for DC transport and is open on Cloud, allowing a fourth reader to be added without the cursor loop

Test suite validates all six acceptance criteria including recovered item count equality, cursor token advancement in request bodies, independent termination conditions (isLast and exhausted token), infinite loop detection, mutation killing, and structural regression prevention
